verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for any online service, including IRS.gov and its online account tools, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an analytics, cookie or usage-tracking opt-out. The ID.me note that biometric data is automatically deleted concerns identity-verification data retention, which is an adjacent behavior and not a user-controlled telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
